success_patterns: For follow-up constraints, retrieve the compatible cached result that already includes the most active criteria, apply the matching filter, and save the filtered result.
When mandatory information is missing, ask only for the missing details instead of making a partial or speculative search.
For a new, fully specified request, pass the supported criteria from the conversation literally and save the search result.
